**Build passes now.** The error was two real bugs, not noise.

`options.retries` was renamed to `retryCount` by the bump. It threw. Now [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) takes both.

`backoffEnabled` came back `undefined`, and the strict check threw on it. [retryPolicy.js:9](src/net/retryPolicy.js:9) now reads unset as `false`.

The 8 warnings are hardcoded strings in [build.js:18](build.js:18). No source file backs them.

Next: confirm `backoff disabled` is the default you want.
